# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.5.0

Version 1.5.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.15

**Vulkan and Direct3D 12.** **Settings** → **Video** → **Graphics API** now chooses what the game draws with, from the
next start:

- **OpenGL** (the default, as before): OpenGL 3.3 on Windows and Linux, OpenGL ES 3.0 on Android.
- **Vulkan**: Windows, Linux and Android 7.0 or later, with a Vulkan driver.
- **Direct3D 12**: Windows 10 or later.

All three draw the same picture. Vulkan and Direct3D 12 leave the CPU more time: the driver does less work for each
thing drawn, the shaders are prepared on another thread while you play, and they are kept in `shader_cache/` for the
next start. That helps most on phones and slower PCs; which API is fastest on a given GPU depends on its driver, so it
is worth trying them. On phones, Vulkan also keeps the depth buffer (and, with MSAA, the multisampled picture) on the
GPU chip instead of writing it to memory at every frame, which saves memory bandwidth and power.

- If the chosen API cannot start on a device (no driver, an older GPU or Windows), the game uses OpenGL and the menu
  says so. If the game crashes as it starts with Vulkan or Direct3D 12 (a driver problem), the next start uses OpenGL
  and sets it in the menu, so the menu stays reachable. If the GPU stops responding while playing, the game ends with
  a message and also starts with OpenGL the next time.
- `renderer` in `settings.ini` is the same setting (0 OpenGL, 1 Vulkan, 2 Direct3D 12); `--renderer vulkan` (or
  `opengl`, `d3d12`) uses an API for one run.

**A faster renderer, with every API.** The game's GameCube-style shader (the TEV stages, lighting, fog, texture
coordinates) was one big program that checked every option for every pixel. Now each combination the game uses gets a
shader of its own that leaves out what it does not use; the general shader draws until that one is ready, so a new
combination never makes the game wait. On top of that each draw sends its settings in a few blocks instead of about 27
separate calls, a vertex is 36 bytes instead of 96, and OpenGL keeps its compiled shaders between starts. In the test
container (a software renderer, frame limiter off) the title demo now plays **3.2 times as fast** as with v1.4.15.

- The menus, the minimap, the touch gamepad and the NES games now draw through the same small set of calls on every
  API (one shader for the minimap, the touch pad and the NES picture instead of three).
- `specialized_shaders = 0` in `settings.ini` draws with the general shader only (in case a driver has trouble with
  the specialized ones).
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.5.0 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

In the test container, whose GPU is Mesa's software renderer (llvmpipe for OpenGL, lavapipe for Vulkan), with the
title demo playing the same frames every run (`--deterministic`):

| Title demo, 4,800 frames, frame limiter off | v1.4.14 (the renderer of v1.4.15) | v1.5.0 |
|---|---|---|
| OpenGL | 115.7 s | **36.1 s** (3.2× as fast) |
| Vulkan (lavapipe) | — | 50.6 s |

- OpenGL's screenshots are byte for byte those of v1.4.14/v1.4.15 (the title demo, the town map opened over the town,
  the touch gamepad, the pause menu; desktop OpenGL and OpenGL ES 3.0).
- Scripted play on the Korean-patched disc, v1.4.14 against v1.5.0 with OpenGL, 18 runs and 4,250 screenshots: a new
  game into town, every building, furnishing and saving, the town by night, in snow and in rain, about 40 submenus,
  the New Year countdown, the harvest festival, K.K. Slider, the broker, the Korean editors, the paths without an SD
  card or GBA, a part-time job step and a Famicom game. The logged positions and the saves are identical in every run;
  39 screenshots differ, each by 1 (of 255) in a color channel on 1 to 4 pixels (rounding in the specialized shaders),
  the rest are identical.
- They found one problem of the new renderer, fixed before this release: a white box over the top left of the NES
  games. On the GameCube the game shows its NES emulator's picture there; on PC the NES picture comes from FixNES, that
  picture was never filled, and the old renderer happened to leave it out (afe-decomp now leaves it out on PC).
- Vulkan, with the Khronos validation layers on: no validation errors in any of the runs. Its screenshots differ from
  OpenGL's by at most 1 (of 255) in a color channel on about 0.02% of the pixels; the touch gamepad's ring edges by a
  pixel; with 4x MSAA and the HD texture pack only along polygon edges (where the samples lie). Resizing the window
  (16:9, portrait, 720p) works.
- Direct3D 12, Windows build under Wine 11 (vkd3d): the same screenshots differ from OpenGL's as little as Vulkan's
  (the title demo, the town map, the pause menu); with 4x MSAA and all 19,061 textures of the HD pack (BC7) it matches
  the Vulkan run; a resolution change in the settings works. The Windows build's Vulkan draws the same.
- On a software renderer the CPU does the GPU's work, so Vulkan comes out slower there (50.6 s against 36.1 s); this
  says little about real GPUs, where the driver's CPU time is what Vulkan and Direct3D 12 save.
- All unit tests pass. Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.5.0,
  versionCode 10500); the APK carries the Vulkan renderer for both ABIs.

## Known limitations

- Vulkan and Direct3D 12 were checked on software renderers only (Mesa on Linux, Wine for Direct3D 12), not yet on
  real GPUs or phones. Please report problems with the API you use in [Issues](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/issues);
  OpenGL stays the default.
- The first start with Direct3D 12 compiles the general shader once (a few seconds before the title screen); later
  starts take it from `shader_cache/`.
- Lines are always one pixel wide with Direct3D 12 (and with Vulkan on GPUs without wide lines); the game hardly draws
  any.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
